description: List the media trash, newest first. Each file shows when it was deleted and when it expires; after that it is deleted permanently. A file with isPurging true is being deleted and cannot be restored. Restore with restore_media. Paginated: while hasMore is true, pass nextCursor back as cursor while it is set; if hasMore is true but nextCursor is null, page with the offset instead, and past offset 10000 narrow the filter.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. The page continues after it in the same filter and sort; leave the skip/offset at 0 when you pass it

limit.description: How many files to return, at most 100

offset.description: How many rows to skip, at most 10000; page past that with cursor

name: list_trashed_media
title: List trashed media
